business_summary.text: Bharti Airtel is a global communications solutions provider and India's second-largest mobile operator, offering 4G/5G mobile, Wi-Fi, and enterprise solutions.

call_points.text: FY27 capex expected in the ballpark of FY26, when India excluding passive capex was about ₹31,000 Cr.
No numeric capex guidance given; management said it does not typically give guidance.
Q4 mobile ARPU was ₹257, up ₹3 on an EDB basis; management said it is not happy with the increase.
Nxtra raised $1 billion from marquee investors alongside Airtel, towards a 1 GW data centre ambition.
Airtel plans 56 edge data centres over the next 18 to 24 months.
Chipset and memory price rises have made fixed wireless access more expensive than fiber, prompting a pivot to fiber.
West Asia crisis is hitting international roaming, capex via INR depreciation, tower build-outs and energy prices.
Financial services allocation stated at ₹20,000 Cr over five years, of which ₹14,000 Cr from Airtel, possibly less.

2026-05-01: Bharti Airtel pays ₹2.1 lakh penalty to DoT Madhya Pradesh for subscriber verification norms violation
On May 7, 2026, Bharti Airtel announced the launch of Airtel Secure Workforce, a managed Zero Trust Architecture security solution for enterprises.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹55,383.2 Cr (+15.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹7,325.1 Cr (-33.5% YoY).
Bharti Airtel Limited’s Board recommended ₹24 per share final dividend for FY 2025-26 on May 13, 2026, pending AGM approval.
Bharti Airtel's board approved a preferential share issue of up to 146.76 Mn shares at ₹1,923 each to acquire up to a 16.31% stake in Airtel Africa on May 13, 2026.
Bharti Airtel Limited, via Krishan Puri and Rohit Krishan Puri, uploaded the Q4 FY26 earnings call recording on May 14, 2026, at https://www.airtel.in/about-bharti/equity/results.

On May 15, 2026, Bharti Airtel disclosed a ₹1.06 lakh penalty notice from DoT Uttar Pradesh (East) over alleged subscriber verification violations from a March 2026 CAF audit, which it will pay without contesting.
Bharti Airtel launched Priority Postpaid services leveraging 5G slicing technology.

Bharti Airtel filed the transcript of its 14 May 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, where management guided FY27 capex to stay near FY26's ~₹31,000 Cr India spend and flagged chipset and memory cost inflation.
On May 26, 2026, Bharti Airtel received a ₹1.57 lakh penalty notice from DoT Maharashtra over subscriber verification norms.
Network i2i Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Bharti Airtel, completed the redemption of USD 500 million subordinated perpetual securities.

2026-08-10: Bharti Airtel released the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call; where management reported consolidated revenue of ₹58,500 Cr (up 5.7% QoQ); ARPU of ₹264; and outlined data centre and Africa growth plans.
Bharti Airtel received a ₹1.5 lakh penalty from DoT Madhya Pradesh for subscriber verification norms violation.

watchlist.response: Management said the pricing architecture is "broken" and needs repair, but gave no timeline and said it would act with caution.
watchlist.text: Analyst pressed on whether tariff hikes are realistic given weak ARPU growth.

watchlist.response: Soumen Ray said it was a prudence provision on an existing matter, not a new demand, and declined to give specifics.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked about the regulatory charge taken this quarter.

watchlist.response: Management did not provide a churn number, saying the issue was aggressive low pricing leading to poor acquisition quality, and that they are tightening it.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the churn rate in FWA and whether growth can be maintained despite higher churn.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give a forecast, saying it will turn positive once scale is reached.
